text:
lina: Hi all — first day! Quick ask: I need Figma access (Redwood org + 'Redwood UI' library), the Product Roadmap Notion page, and the Research folder in Drive. Who should I ping for invites? Also any must-dos for a Product/Design newcomer this week?

marco.designops: welcome @lina :tada: — I'll add you to the Figma team and the design Google group. Which email should I use? For Notion, request access via the Product Requests form (link below). I'll also share the Research folder once you confirm the drive email.

lina: lina@redwood.com — thanks! Could you also add me to Miro/stickerboard workspace? We'll be doing a prototype workshop next Friday.

marco.designops: noted. Miro access coming.

aisha.design: hey @lina, welcome! A few quick pointers:
- Design crits are Tue 10am (recurring) — please bring 1 mock or flow next week if you can.
- We keep async critique notes in #design and a weekly digest in Notion.
- In Figma, enable the 'Redwood UI' library via Assets > Libraries. The file name is "Redwood UI — v2".
- We also have a Design Onboarding page in Notion: Products > Design > Onboarding (it has the checklist).

lina: got it, will enable library. Is there a short checklist for "first-week" tasks?

sam.pm: @lina — welcome! First-week priorities we ask new PMs/designers to do:
1) Join the weekly stand + design crit (Tue).
2) Read recent roadmap doc (Notion: Product > Roadmap > Q2).
3) Shadow one user-research session (we try to have 1 per week).
4) Get staging access for interacting with prototypes.

lina: where do I request staging access?

marco.designops: file a request in #eng-requests with subject `access: staging` and include your email + repo/feature you'll test. I can ping infra to expedite if you add `@marco.designops` in the thread.

devon.research: hi @lina — I'm the research ops contact. I'll get you added to the Research Drive folder and the recruitment pipeline. A few notes: we use the Notion "Research Plan (template)" — please duplicate and populate the screener. Recruiting is handled via the /recruit bot or ping me directly. We reimburse $15 per participant by default.

lina: thanks! For the recruitment pipeline, is there a flow for internal participants?

devon.research: internal testing is fine for early prototypes — use the 'Internal Usability' tag on the plan, and add the internal participant spreadsheet. If you want external participants, mark `external: true` and I will kick off recruitment.

marco.designops: FYI @aisha.design — Lina is on my team for the next two sprints, will join the "Checkout Revamp" squad.

aisha.design: great — will loop her into the design board and the weekly sync.

deploy-bot: @lina has been added to the `design-team` Google group and invited to the Redwood Figma org.

lina: perfect, I see the invites. One last Q: any recommended quick reads on our research playbook or previous design decisions for Checkout?

sam.pm: read: Notion > Product Decisions > Checkout (last 6 months) and the 'Checkout research synthesis' doc in the Research folder. Also ping me if you'd like a 30min walkthrough.

lina: amazing, thanks everyone :pray: — will start the checklist and DM if I hit blockers.

marco.designops: welcome again! If anything is stuck, tag me — I usually handle permissions and tooling.

devon.research: added a short task list for you in the Research folder: `observe 1 session`, `duplicate research plan`, `request recruitment` — ping me when ready.

aisha.design: short checklist recap (copy here so it's easy):
- Enable 'Redwood UI' Figma library
- Accept Figma/Google/Notion invites
- Join Tue 10am design crit
- Shadow one research session
- File #eng-requests ticket for staging access
- Read Product Decisions > Checkout (recent)

lina: copying checklist now. Thanks everyone! :heart:
